senses.gloss: (יחר, cmp. אחר, a. חֲלִיפִין) a young shoot, esp. of a fig-tree.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:1:10">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> top <he>כיי׳ שהוא נוטה וכ׳</he> like a shoot (of a fig-tree) hanging over into a court (ref. to Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:10">Maasr. III, 10</cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>יִחוּרִים</he>, <cite ref="J00271"><he>יִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:14">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, end … <he>הכניס עמו י׳ לתאנים</he> he (Noah) took with him … shoots for the preservation of fig-trees; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:14">ib.</cite> s. 36 <he>י׳ של תאנה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:2:5">Y. B. Kam. VI, 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>יִיחוּרֵי תאנים</he>; Bab.
